policyUpdates.title: New rooftop-solar subsidy detected for Maharashtra.
policyUpdates.summary: MERC issues notification revising DISCOM net-meter commissioning SLA to 15 days with mandatory smart bi-directional meters and accelerated Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) disbursal.
changes: Net-meter synchronization SLA capped strictly at 15 days
Mandatory Aadhaar NPCI bank account verification before work order release
Direct escalation channel for unresolved consumer grievances beyond 15 days

policyUpdates.title: Gujarat simplifies vendor PCR submission window.
policyUpdates.summary: Vendors must submit geotagged Project Commissioning Report (PCR) within 7 days of installation, reducing disbursal latency to under 20 days.
changes: Automatic SMS alert to consumer upon vendor report submission

policyUpdates.title: Delhi Solar Policy 2026 expands Generation Based Incentive (GBI).
policyUpdates.summary: Residential consumers can receive ₹3/unit GBI on solar power generated, credited directly on bi-monthly power bills in addition to central DBT subsidy.
changes: Group net-metering enabled for apartment welfare associations

policyVersions.label: Version 1
policyVersions.keyChanges: Legacy baseline subsidy structure with flat CAPEX subsidy for systems up to 5 kW.

policyVersions.label: Version 2
policyVersions.keyChanges: Standardized nationwide under PM-Surya Ghar. Max ₹78,000 capped at 3 kW. Mandatory Aadhaar NPCI seeding for DBT.

policyVersions.label: Version 3
policyVersions.keyChanges: Smart-meter mandate introduced, Time-of-Day (ToD) net feed-in tariffs, and fast-track 15-day DBT disbursal.

policyVersions.label: Version 2.4
policyVersions.keyChanges: Streamlined grievance redressal, DISCOM 15-day net-meter SLA, and automated DBT escalation.

rejectionReasons.title: NPCI Aadhaar Not Mapped
rejectionReasons.severity: Critical (Responsible for 68% of DBT solar subsidy delays)
rejectionReasons.description: The central government disburses solar subsidies exclusively via Aadhaar-enabled Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Bank account is not mapped to Aadhaar payment bridge (APBS). Even if bank KYC is done, NPCI mapping may be absent.
rejectionReasons.solution: Visit your bank branch and submit the 'NPCI Aadhaar Seeding / Mandate Form', or enable DBT mapping via your bank's mobile banking app under 'Services > Manage DBT / Aadhaar Seeding'.
rejectionReasons.checkAction: Verify Aadhaar-seeding status via UIDAI or bank netbanking.

rejectionReasons.title: Vendor PCR Not Uploaded
rejectionReasons.description: Project Commissioning Report (PCR) must be signed and submitted on the National Portal by the registered vendor along with geotagged site photographs and equipment serial numbers.
rejectionReasons.solution: Contact your solar installer/vendor with your National Portal Application ID. Issue an official reminder notice requesting immediate PCR completion.
rejectionReasons.checkAction: Track vendor submission status in the National Portal.

rejectionReasons.title: DISCOM Meter Inspection Pending
rejectionReasons.description: DISCOM SLA requires net-meter synchronization within 15 days of installation. Beyond this, escalation applies. The junior engineer must verify synchronization on the national portal.
rejectionReasons.solution: Lodge an SLA escalation with your local DISCOM sub-division junior engineer citing your Work Order / Application ID.

rejectionReasons.title: Name Mismatch (Electricity Bill vs Bank Account)
rejectionReasons.description: Consumer name registered on the electricity connection must match the name on the bank passbook / cancelled cheque.
rejectionReasons.solution: Upload a cancelled cheque and a name declaration affidavit under Discrepancy Resolution on the national portal.
